epic.title: Game data pipeline
epic.description: Daily import of game files and PvPoke, Portuguese names, the calculation engine ported from Python (checked against golden files), verification and publishing, sprites.

features.title: Daily import job
tasks: Container Apps Job scheduled daily at 06:00
Download game master and PvPoke gamemaster and rankings
Parse species, forms, versions, stats, moves (raid + PvP), learnsets, Elite TM / legacy flags
Upsert with change counts per kind
Run log: start, end, duration, what changed, errors

features.title: Portuguese names from game text
tasks: Download game text and map Pokémon, move and type names
Fallback to English and report missing names

features.title: Calculation engine (port of the Python pipeline)
features.description: Golden files from Sprint 0 must match exactly before the Python page is retired.
tasks: CP formula, CP multipliers, max CP L40/50/51, 100% CP at L15/20/25/30/35
PvP: stat product, best level under the cap, IV rank of all 4,096 spreads per league
Keeper boxes: appraisal bars within 98% of rank 1, best box (F1)
Raid engine: comprehensive DPS / TDO and score, Shadow and Mega bonuses, one Mega slot
Boss move modelling: damage from the boss's moves; re-rank counters by chosen moves
Type effectiveness for single and dual types (×1.6 / ×0.63 / ×0.39)

features.title: Verification and publishing
tasks: Game-search simulator (port of searchsim) checks every generated string
Sanity checks: counts, ranks, no missing species
Publish atomically; on failure keep yesterday's data live and log why
'Run now' trigger for the admin

features.title: Sprites
tasks: Fetch game sprites, trim to content, square; store in Blob storage with CDN caching
Shiny and Mega variants
Fallback image when a sprite is missing
